item.title: Do you want a new Lord of the Rings RTS? This Total War: Attila mod has given the game a popularity boost
item.description: Total War Attila has seen a surge in players recently, thanks to the 1.0 release of an ambitious mod that totally overhauls the game into a Lord of the Rings grand strategy experience. Titled The Dawnless Days, the mod has led to the largest peak in concurrent players for Attila in almost a decade. Read more

item.title: Megabonk gets spooky update just in time for the festive season, with new map, character and more
item.description: Nothing spreads the festive cheer quite like spooky things, right? Well, ok, I can think of a few other things that are probably higher up the festive list, but for Megabonk fans, spooky is what's on the cards. Read more

item.title: "The impact of time dilation is something very unique and fresh" - sci-fi RPG Exodus looks like Mass Effect but there's a very important difference
item.description: Exodus looks a lot like Mass Effect - let's get that out of the way. Not only does Archetype's space-faring RPG have the same look and the same sensibilities, right down to getting a spaceship and gathering a crew in order to save the day, but it's made by some of same the people who dreamt Mass Effect up, including, notably, lead Mass Effect 1 & 2 writer Drew Karpyshyn. Read more

item.description: Divinity: Original Sin 2 now has current gen versions available for Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. Read more

item.title: Arc Raiders is getting festive tomorrow, as new environmental effects liven up outdoor maps
item.description: Arc Raiders' Flickering Flames event kicks off tomorrow, and with it a blanket of snow will land softly over a variety of outdoor maps. While exciting, it'll make these dangerous maps even more perilous thanks to new environmental effects and frostbite. Read more

item.title: Stalker 2 is adding "hours" of new quests in a major free update coming very, very soon
item.description: 'Tis the season to be jolly, even if you happen to be ankle-deep in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Yup, Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl 2 is getting into the seasonal spirit of giving with a completely free update promising "hours" of new quests and more - all arriving on Tuesday, 16th December. Read more

item.title: Fallout's Todd Howard has no interest in becoming Bethesda's version of Marvel cameo king Stan Lee
item.description: The second season of Amazon's Fallout adaptation is due to air in just a couple of days time, but don't expect to see Bethesda studio head Todd Howard popping up as a cameo. Read more

item.title: After "gutting" its video game division, Amazon has sold one of its studios to Ubisoft
item.description: Following Amazon's decision to 'gut' its video game division in October as part of 14,000 job cuts across the company, Ubisoft has announced the acquisition of one of its studios - Amazon Games Montreal - which is currently working on MOBA March of Giants. Read more

item.title: Six months after being delayed indefinitely, Bungie's troubled Marathon finally gets release window and price
item.description: Six month after announcing an indefinite delay for Marathon in response to "passionate" community feedback, Bungie has slapped its live-service extraction shooter with a release window and price, confirming it'll launch for PlayStation 5 and PC in March next year for £35. Read more
